# JAPP

> JAPP is a job application management workspace: manage your CV, save job opportunities and
> companies, generate tailored cover letters with AI, and track every application from applied
> to offer.

JAPP brings together five things that are usually scattered across spreadsheets, email threads,
and browser tabs during a job search:

- **CV management** — upload and reuse your CV across cover letters and applications.
- **Jobs** — save job postings with the role, location, and details that matter.
- **Companies** — keep track of the companies you're applying to.
- **Applications** — turn a saved job into a real application and follow it from applied to offer.
- **Cover letters** — generate a cover letter tailored to a job description and your CV, using a
  configured AI provider.

## Tech stack

Angular (frontend), Spring Boot (backend, Java, multi-module Maven), PostgreSQL (database),
JWT-based authentication.

## Status

JAPP is a personal project, currently in open beta. Use the contact form on the site to request
early access.
